/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'review_bundle=$(mktemp -d /tmp/kk-settings-review.XXXXXX)
python3 - "$review_bundle" <<'"'PY'
import hashlib, json, pathlib, subprocess, sys
root = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
repo = pathlib.Path.cwd()
plugin = pathlib.Path('/home/sergio/.codex/plugins/cache/fr-r7-bf873de6-20261013/kk/0.23.0')
def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args])
base = git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip()
release = git('rev-parse', 'eval-release"'^{commit}'"').decode().strip()
provenance = []
def snapshot(rev, original, category):
    data = git('show', f'{rev}:{original}')
    path = root / category / original
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_bytes(data)
    path.chmod(0o444)
    provenance.append({'repository':str(repo), 'revision':rev or 'index (based on '+base+')', 'original_path':original, 'snapshot':str(path), 'git_blob':git('rev-parse',f'{rev}:{original}').decode().strip(),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'line_span':[1,len(data.splitlines())], 'omitted_or_redacted':'none'})
    return str(path)
candidate = [snapshot('', p, 'candidate') for p in ['client.py','tests/test_client.py']]
context_files = [snapshot('', p, 'context') for p in ['README.md','docs/feat/wip/enhanced-settings/design.md','docs/feat/wip/enhanced-settings/implementation.md','docs/feat/wip/enhanced-settings/tasks.md']]
historical = [snapshot(release,'provider/settings.py','historical/release'),snapshot(base,'client.py','historical/base'),snapshot(base,'tests/test_client.py','historical/base')]
diff = root/'staged.patch'
diff.write_bytes(git('diff','--cached','--no-ext-diff','--binary'))
diff.chmod(0o444)
prov = root/'provenance.json'
prov.write_text(json.dumps(provenance,indent=2)+'\\n')
prov.chmod(0o444)
common = [str(plugin/'skills/review-code'/p) for p in ['functional-review.md','shared-change-context.md','shared-review-scope-protocol.md','shared-capy-knowledge-protocol.md']]
checklists = [str(plugin/'profiles/python/review-code'/p) for p in ['security-checklist.md','solid-checklist.md','code-quality-checklist.md','removal-plan.md']]
criteria=common+checklists
assert len(criteria)==8 and len(set(criteria))==8 and all(pathlib.Path(p).is_file() for p in criteria)
context = f'''# Change context
Intent: task 1 adds client receipt handling; README and design require every merged client increment to support provider eval-release for ordinary settings saves, including enhanced_settings=False. Success means values applied AND caller sees success. Explicit documented requirement.
Selector: git diff --cached; two modified files, 4 additions and 2 deletions. No unstaged changes at capture. Candidate index blobs and review-base source are in provenance.json.
Review base: {base}. Candidate: staged index on that base; client blob {git('rev-parse',':client.py').decode().strip()} and test blob {git('rev-parse',':tests/test_client.py').decode().strip()}.
Compatibility baseline: local tag eval-release resolves to {release}; actual provider source supplied. This is a source-level comparison, not verification of a live environment. README says no live environment is required.
Existing behavior to preserve: ordinary save passes settings through send(workspace_id, request), then returns saved/enhanced to caller on successful application. Historical base and provider source supplied to independently assess these contracts.
Delivery: client/provider ship independently; candidate provider not deployed. Feature UI disabled by default. No accepted exception to independent delivery.
Verification at dispatch: source inspected by parent; no tests executed yet. Capy pattern and Python idiom lookups returned empty knowledge base. No implementation narrative or rejected approaches supplied.

## Task Scope
Review mode: mid-implementation
In scope: Task 1: Client receipt handling — status done; client.py and tests/test_client.py; explicitly requested review.
Out of scope: Task 2: Provider receipts — status pending; separate provider repository; do not flag its absence as missing implementation.
Pending work does not excuse current regressions or incompatibility. The full feature design describes future end state; assess current increment against the documented delivery contract.

## Coverage and tool limits
PAL codereview and listmodels tools are unavailable; independent code-reviewer is sole external reviewer. Actual source and criteria receipts must be reported. Parent will execute existing tests and targeted verification separately.
'''
ctx=root/'change-context.md';ctx.write_text(context);ctx.chmod(0o444)
manifest={'plugin_root':str(plugin),'review_selector':'git diff --cached','review_base':base,'release_baseline':release,'instructions':criteria,'active_profiles':[{'profile':'python','checklist':p,'triggered_by':'content signal: .py extension of client.py and tests/test_client.py; always load'} for p in checklists],'review_evidence':{'diff':str(diff),'candidate_sources':candidate},'historical_evidence':historical+[str(prov)],'intent_context':context_files+[str(ctx)],'gate_ledger':{'bootstrap_parts_read':6,'profile_index_parts_read':1,'checklist_parts_read':2,'criteria_set_reconciled':criteria}}
(root/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\\n')
print(json.dumps({'bundle':str(root),'manifest':str(root/'manifest.json'),'criteria_count':len(criteria),'source_snapshots':len(provenance)},indent=2))
PY"
